reviewPassage:
Support reference: checkout display

A new checkout screen shows the amount the customer has paid in bold. A gray line may display a delivery estimate while an order is being prepared.

Start with the order history. A gray amount with no receipt number is informational. Staff should not copy it into the paid-total field. A gray amount with a receipt number, by contrast, belongs to an actual transaction.

A numbered delivery line does not always warrant an accounting request. Orders split into separate boxes may show two numbered delivery lines. The packing list has one entry per box. Compare it with the order history before escalating. Escalate if both numbered delivery lines refer to the same packing entry. Two separate boxes going to the same address are not, by themselves, a reason to escalate.

Send the relevant receipt numbers, not screenshots of the complete customer account. The accounting team can look up the record using those numbers alone.

新版結帳畫面以粗體顯示顧客已付款的金額。訂單備貨期間，灰色明細列可能會顯示預估運費。

先查看訂單記錄。沒有收據編號的灰色金額只供參考。客服人員不應把它填入已付款總額欄。相較之下，有收據編號的灰色金額屬於實際交易。

有編號的運費不一定需要請會計處理。分箱的訂單可能會出現兩筆有編號的運費。裝箱清單每個箱子各有一筆紀錄。轉請會計處理前，先把裝箱清單與訂單記錄對照。若兩筆有編號的運費明細都對應同一筆裝箱紀錄，就轉請會計處理。兩個不同的箱子寄往同一地址，本身不是轉請會計處理的理由。

請提供相關收據編號，不要傳送完整顧客帳戶的截圖。會計小組單憑這些編號就能查找該筆記錄。
